review_notes: Do not create a third ISceneViewFamilyRenderer for World2D.
Do not pre-commit to four shader files or multiple batch facades; use a capability matrix.
World2D MVP is a linear SceneColor pass after bloom graph and before finalize/tone-map.
CameraComponent must not read View/window state or mutate Transform while producing a view.
Game UI placement is separate from World2D and has four explicit target scopes.
Do not duplicate Render2D Vulkan checks or global session state in new paths.
Do not claim multi-window completion while displayRootTask remains first-root scoped.
